item.title: More than 4K without power in Horry County
item.description: HORRY COUNTY, S.C. (WBTW) -- More than 4,000 Santee Cooper customers were without power Sunday morning, according to the utility's outage map. As of 1 a.m., 4,085 customers were affected from 10 outages clustered around North Myrtle Beach. Officials did not immediately provide an estimated restoration time.
